summary: The famous wine countries are the answer: France, Italy, Spain, the US, Australia, Chile, Argentina, South Africa and Portugal all come fast, and only China at #5 surprises.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. Two casual orders found 10 and 9; lives went on Germany (#12), New Zealand (#18), Greece (#16) and Mexico. Too easy for Today's list.
FAO's 2021 production by weight (70 countries). Wine words (champagne, napa, bordeaux, malbec) are free; every country is an answer.
A good Blitz: 69 countries carry a figure and a casual names about 20, nearly all scoring.
fixes: If a judge agrees on free play, drop its `debut` flag in topics.ts, or it waits out of random play for good.
